T1.implementation_approach: Use a frontend framework like React or Angular to design a user-friendly interface for browsing, searching, and filtering problems.
T1.notes: Focus on responsive design and intuitive navigation.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs using a backend framework to handle CRUD operations for problems.
T2.notes: Ensure proper validation and error handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Design a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata.
data_structures: Tables for problems, tags, and metadata
T3.notes: Optimize for search and filtering queries.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a form-based interface for users to submit code, with syntax highlighting and file upload support.
T4.notes: Include validation for supported programming languages.

T5.implementation_approach: Implement APIs to handle code submission, queue processing, and result storage.
T5.notes: Ensure scalability and concurrency for code evaluation.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a database schema to store code submissions, results, and logs.
data_structures: Tables for submissions, results, and logs
T6.notes: Include indexing for faster retrieval of results.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a profile page to display user details, activity, and achievements.
T7.notes: Include options for editing profile information.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage user profiles, including CRUD operations and authentication.
T8.notes: Ensure secure handling of user data.

T9.implementation_approach: Design a database schema to store user information, preferences, and activity logs.
data_structures: Tables for user details, preferences, and logs
T9.notes: Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations.

T10.implementation_approach: Create a leaderboard interface to display rankings, scores, and filters for sorting.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to fetch and update leaderboard data based on user performance.
T11.notes: Implement caching for frequently accessed data.

T12.implementation_approach: Design a database schema to store leaderboard data, including user scores and rankings.

T13.implementation_approach: Design an interface to display hints and solutions for problems, with access control.
data_structures: State management for hints and solutions
T13.notes: Ensure hints and solutions are displayed conditionally based on user progress.

T14.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage hints and solutions, including access control and versioning.
T14.notes: Ensure secure access to premium content.

T15.implementation_approach: Design a database schema to store hints and solutions, with metadata for access control.
data_structures: Tables for hints, solutions, and metadata
T15.notes: Include versioning for updates to hints and solutions.

T16.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests to verify the functionality of the problem repository.
T16.notes: Focus on edge cases and performance testing.

T17.implementation_approach: Simulate code submissions and evaluate the correctness and performance of the evaluation backend.
data_structures: Mock data for submissions and results

T18.implementation_approach: Test user profile functionality, including CRUD operations and authentication.

T19.implementation_approach: Verify the accuracy and performance of the leaderboard functionality.
T19.notes: Test for real-time updates and sorting.

T20.implementation_approach: Test the functionality and access control of hints and solutions.

T20.notes: Ensure proper access control mechanisms are in place.

T21.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform using a cloud provider, with CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment.
